description: Load a URL in the tab of a RUNNING profile and wait for its load event (up to 15 s); on timeout it PROCEEDS ANYWAY and the result says the page is still loading - then call wait_for_element for what you need before reading the page. The profile must already be open - call launch_profile first; this never opens it.

profile_id.description: UUID of a running profile (launch_profile first)

name: navigate
